name: Status Report Items 2
definition: Describes a transaction and its status.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification assigned by the matching application to the transaction.|This identification is to be used in any communication between the parties.

ReportedEntity.name: Reported Entity
ReportedEntity.definition: Entity for which the matching application has generated a report.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Identifies the status of the transaction by means of a code.

SubStatus.name: Sub Status
SubStatus.definition: Further description of the transaction status.
